pages.text: The Processor converts energy liquids into fuel liquids with two recipes:$(li)$(bold)Nether Compound Fuel$(reset): 1 solid + 1000 mb Nether Compound Energy → 1000 mb, 5M per batch$(li)$(bold)Pure Fuel$(reset): 1 solid + 100 mb Nether Pure Energy → 75 mb, a light concentration that consumes few solids$(br2)Pure Fuel has a low volume but is a top-tier Mixer ingredient, so the concentration step is required.

$(bold)Operation:$(reset) one recipe at a time; switching materials resets progress, so one line should be run to completion.$(br2)Line selection:$(li)volume: Nether Compound Fuel, a 1:1 conversion$(li)purity: Pure Fuel, used by the $(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l) for Ultimate Mixture$(br2)Either output is sent to the $(l:akaishi:fuel_canner)Fuel Canner$(/l) and then to the Reactor as canned fuel.
Feedstock comes from the $(l:akaishi:fuel_liquefier)Energy Liquefier$(/l); for fuel blending, see $(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l).
